title: May Admin Phase 1 — Operational Efficiency Analysis

prePlatformModel.methodology: Estimated based on S252-S262 documentation describing pre-platform investigation workflow. Pre-platform required manual grep across 5+ registry files, manual cross-referencing, and manual report compilation.

operations.operation: Parse pack item fields (stem, choices, correct, explanation)
Manual cross-reference: verify challenge IDs resolve in registry
Manual cross-reference: verify investigation IDs resolve
Manual cross-reference: verify recommendation IDs resolve

prePlatformModel.assumption: Conservative estimates — assumes experienced administrator familiar with file structure. Novice administrators would take 2-3x longer.

registryTraversals.after: 0 — single CLI call returns unified dossier

crossReferences.after: Automated — all FK links pre-resolved in data bundle

clicksAndNavigations.before: Manual file opens, grep commands, reading output, switching between terminals/editors
clicksAndNavigations.after: Single-page dashboard with searchable tables, sortable columns, cross-view linking

informationDensity.before: Scattered across 5+ files, requires manual aggregation
informationDensity.after: 9-section dossier in single CLI call, 4 view dashboard with click-to-expand detail cards

questionView.searchable: Text search (QID/topic), section filter (A-F), health tier filter (4 tiers)
questionView.sortable: 6 columns (QID, Section, Topic, State, Health, Defects)
questionView.detailCard: Pack, Section, Difficulty, Cognitive Level, State, Health gauge, Defect badges, Linked challenges, Linked investigations, CLI command reference

challengeView.searchable: Text search (ID, type, QID), status filter (5 statuses)
challengeView.detailCard: Type, Status, Question (clickable cross-link), Triage, Priority, Confidence, Linked investigations, Linked recommendations, Linked sessions, Question health
challengeView.crossViewLinking: Challenge detail → click question → switches to Question view

sessionView.detailCard: Series, Date, Mode, Questions (total + certified + ratio), QID list, Linked challenges, recommendations, investigations

recommendationView.detailCard: Type, Severity, Status, Target QIDs, Source scan, Created session/timestamp, Lifecycle, QID list, Linked investigations

globalHeader.realtime: Updates on page load from data bundle

operationalCharacteristics.dataPreIndexed: 1,260 KB single script load — no runtime network requests
operationalCharacteristics.styling: Reuses learner app styles.css CSS variables

comparisonSummary.administrativeCapacityIncrease: One admin can do in <1ms (warm) or 83ms (cold) what previously took ~135 seconds — a 1,627x reduction (cold)
comparisonSummary.verdict: The May Admin platform eliminates all manual registry traversal, reduces a ~2-minute manual investigation to a ~50ms CLI call, and provides a fully searchable dashboard for routine administrative work.
